entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Support.
Connecting you to a support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit Support, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. Order number is VF-8675309.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... VF-8675309. I see an order for one VeloBand Pulse. Is that the item?
Yes, that's the one. It's just not what I expected. I need a return label.
I can certainly look into that. Let's see... according to the tracking information, this was delivered to you 11 days ago. Is that correct?
I guess? It was last week sometime. What does that matter? Just send me the label.

Well, sir, I'm seeing an alert here. The VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return window due to the electronic components. Our standard 90-day policy doesn't apply to this particular item. Since it's been 11 days, the system has automatically closed the return window.
Are you kidding me? Ten days? It's one day over! I had a busy week. That's a ridiculous policy. So you're saying I'm stuck with it?
I understand your frustration, and I do apologize for the inconvenience. The policy is strict on this product line...
This is unacceptable. I want to speak to a manager.
Hold on, sir. Let me... let me see what I can do. Look, I'm not supposed to do this, and frankly, my manager would kill me if she found out. But since it is only one day...
So you can fix it?
Technically, no. The system is locked. But... I'm going to try and manually override the system. Please bear with me for a moment, it might take a few tries.
Fine. Just get it done.

Okay... processing... and... there. Okay, I was able to push it through. I've processed this as a one-time exception for you. The return label has just been sent to the email address on file. You should see it in the next couple of minutes.
Oh. Wow, really? You got it?
Yes, sir. The return is authorized. Just make sure to send it back in the original packaging, and your refund will be processed as soon as we receive it.
Okay, great. Seriously, thank you. I was about to lose my mind. I really appreciate you doing that for me.
It's no problem at all. I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Nope, that's it. You've been a huge help. Thanks again, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
